items.title: Scheme-theoretic support of the kernel of the pullback of an almost exact sequence
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the scheme-theoretic support of the kernel of the pullback of an almost exact sequence of modules (author lemma at source lines 5094-5100, label lemma-almost-exactness): if the outer terms are annihilated by a power of the ideal and the last term is an (A, n, c)-module, that kernel is supported on the closed subscheme Y_c. The proof (source lines 5102-5121) localizes to affine opens, identifies the kernel with a Tor module of M against the quotient algebra (proof lines 5102-5116), and then uses the defining property of an (A, n, c)-module — that multiplication by an element of the c-th power factors through a finite free module over the quotient — to show the Tor module is annihilated by that power (proof lines 5116-5120). The identification with Tor is the step with content. H2.
